name: Aurum Pima Polo
tagline: Pima cotton, gold-finish bio wash, built to keep its shape.
short: A 260 GSM polo in 100% Pima cotton with a gold-finish double bio wash and a modern regular fit.
description:
Aurum is made from Pima cotton, chosen for its premium touch. It's cut in a regular fit that we've refined for a modern shape.

The fabric is knitted on Mayer & Cie German machines and finished with a double bio wash (gold), so it feels soft and broken-in from the first wear. We dye it with High Q+ dyes, which keep the colour fast and the polo looking new for longer.

A jacquard collar and cuffs and bartacked side slits finish it off, so it holds its shape and lasts.
fit: Regular fit, refined for a modern shape
features: Regular fit, refined for a modern shape
Knitted on Mayer & Cie German machines
High Q+ dyes for colour fastness

name: Terra Sustainable Polo
tagline: 100% recycled, 100% recyclable. About 5,000 L of water saved per polo.
short: A 240 GSM polo made from recycled plastic and upcycled cotton using Optiknit technology. It's 100% recycled and 100% recyclable.
description:
Terra is made using Turkish Optiknit technology from only recycled plastic and leftover cotton. Each polo uses the cutting leftovers from three T-shirts and four non-biodegradable plastic bottles. Choosing one saves about 5,000 litres of water.

The 240 GSM fabric is 60% recycled cotton and 40% recycled polyester, and it's yarn-dyed with diamond-quality yarn for deep, even colour. It's 100% recycled, 100% recyclable and certified under the Global Recycled Standard.

The finish is polished: a jacquard collar and cuffs, wood-textured buttons and reinforced side slits.
features: Optiknit technology: recycled plastic plus upcycled cotton
About 5,000 litres of water saved and 4 plastic bottles reused per garment

name: Gaia Sustainable Polo
tagline: The women's recycled polo, with 5% Lycra stretch for a clean fitted shape.
short: A women's 240 GSM recycled polo with 5% Lycra stretch, made with Optiknit technology.
description:
Gaia is our women's polo, made the same responsible way as Terra and cut for a clean, fitted shape. It's made with Turkish Optiknit technology from recycled plastic and leftover cotton. Each garment reuses at least four plastic bottles and saves about 5,000 litres of water.

The 240 GSM fabric blends 60% recycled cotton and 35% recycled polyester with 5% Lycra, so it moves with you and keeps its shape all day.

It's yarn-dyed with diamond-quality yarn and finished with a jacquard collar and cuffs, wood-textured buttons and reinforced side slits.

name: Astra Performance Polo
short: A 200 GSM polyester performance polo that manages moisture, resists wrinkles and blocks UV.
description:
Astra is built for long days and warm weather. The 200 GSM polyester fabric draws sweat away from the skin, so you stay dry and comfortable.

It has UV protection built into the fabric, and the wrinkle-free effect keeps it looking sharp from morning to evening. An anti-static finish means less cling.

It comes in 16 colours, from quiet neutrals to bold brights, so it works for teams, uniforms and everyday wear.
